title: DevData Matrix - Technical Text, Log & Code Data Transformer
target_pain: Developers and technical researchers spending hours manually cleaning messy HN/GitHub discussion dumps, deduplicating code logs, parsing CSV/JSON payloads, and searching for syntax markers (C, Rust, Zig).
key_features: Instant Multi-Mode Cleaning: Line trimming, deduplication, HTML stripping, non-ASCII filter, and case normalizing
Real-time Regex Match & Group Replacer with live regex test highlighting
Systems Programming & Tech Stack Detector: Auto-detects Rust, Zig, C/C++, Go, and memory-safety constructs
Bidirectional CSV / TSV / JSON Converter with interactive data grid
1-Click Export to JSON, CSV, or Cleaned Plain Text with Clipboard Copying
